description: This file contains the implementation of logging classes for the Orleans testing host, including a file-based log output handler and a file logger that utilizes this output for logging messages to a file.

classes.name: FileLoggingOutput
classes.description: Manages writing log messages to a file, including handling thread safety, flushing, and disposal.

classes.name: FileLogger
classes.description: An implementation of ILogger that writes log messages to a FileLoggingOutput instance.

methods.name: Log<TState>
methods.description: Logs a message with specified level, event id, state, exception, and formatter.

methods.name: BeginScope<TState>
methods.description: Begins a logical operation scope (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a log level is enabled (always true in this implementation).
